details: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit 014df59b. The release integrates the approved RepeaterBook API relay, expands read-only Icom IC-F50V/F60V channel support, handles echoing cables on the Wouxun KG-689E, and carries related UI and error-reporting fixes.
